clips.title: The story
paras: At the Great Lift, Grish Longrunner watches the boundary between the southern Barrens and Thousand Needles. The tauren scout carries messages for the Horde and tracks movement across the crossing.

Grish Longrunner keeps watch beside the Great Lift in the southern Barrens. Its platform connects the dry southern Barrens with the canyons of Thousand Needles. Quilboar packs roam nearby, and rival groups threaten the crossing. Grish watches travelers and keeps the Horde informed, so reinforcements can be called where they are needed.
